defaultWorkerClass.description: Platform-selected class assigned to new standalone worker pools. Changing it does not classify legacy pools or move an existing pool.

valuesNamespaces.description: Existing non-tenant namespaces whose Secret and ConfigMap values the controller may GET. Managed tenant namespaces receive separate grants from their tenant chart. Empty grants no additional namespaces.

replicas.description: Admission replicas. Controllers use leader election. Admission fails closed, so with one replica a node drain evicts the only webhook pod and every pool write fails until it runs again.

resources.description: Controller and webhook resource requests and limits.
